findings.observed: Previous verifier checked presence of build_log_sha256 but never read/hashed the corresponding log; verified_build_provenance flag could substitute for missing log bytes.
findings.resolution: New provenance_gate verifies required configure/build/install log bytes, zero exit records, compiler/source/binary identities and runtime linked paths.
findings.ceiling: Log/identity agreement alone is not independent build-execution authority.

findings.observed: New gate initially passed None to hash-only helper for compiler/binary/log hashes; missing expected identity therefore did not reject the record.
findings.resolution: Require lowercase 64-hex SHA256 before every expected compiler/binary/log identity comparison.
findings.review: Independent artifact reviewer reproduced three null-identity cases.

findings.observed: Runner supplies stage-receipt JSON as build_log; checking only that JSON hash does not check actual stdout/stderr referenced by it.
findings.resolution: Each stage now supplies mandatory stdout/stderr identities; new gate hashes actual stream bytes in addition to stage receipt.
findings.ceiling: This closes missing byte checks, not independent execution or scientific authority.

non_findings.detail: Current chat environment lacks pkg-config/autoconf/automake/libtoolize; no native build attempted. This is not callback mathematical failure.
Current NumPy witness cannot be promoted to historical serializer authority without contemporaneous linkage.
